dmToken.title: BYOD / Profile DM Token
dmToken.description: Optional Chrome Enterprise DM Token automatically pushed to the local CEP DLP Agent on BYOD devices.

enforceGate.title: Enforce Local Agent Gatekeeper
enforceGate.description: When true, blocks navigation to protected corporate/GenAI domains unless the local cep-dlp-agent is active.

protectedDomains.title: Protected Corporate & GenAI Domains
protectedDomains.description: List of domains that require cep-dlp-agent to be running locally.

downloadBaseUrl.title: Agent Binary Download Base URL
